question: Does the already-frozen CARRY-PNL-0031 mechanism, and the already-rejected CARRY-STACK-0033 idle-capital conversion, still have positive net economics after the displaced cash return is priced with a frozen daily risk-free benchmark?
authorized_change: Accounting benchmark only. No strategy target, asset, weight, cost, funding rule, window, threshold, or execution assumption changes.

risk_free.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED
risk_free.calendarization: Parse FRED business-day observations as percent per annum, reindex to every calendar day in the requested closed interval, forward-fill only from the latest observation available on or before each day, and hard-fail if the first requested day has no rate.
risk_free.daily_return_conversion: rf_daily = DTB3_percent / 100 / 365.0; simple daily accrual, compounded through time
risk_free.fallback_series: none; any change to SOFR or another series requires a new preregistered ID
risk_free.persistence: Commit the exact daily risk-free sequence used by the first valid run and source metadata so the result remains independently reproducible even if FRED later revises observations.

frozen_windows.carry_pnl_0031: Use the unchanged first-held through funding-end window from CARRY-PNL-0031: 2020-09-15 through 2026-07-30.
frozen_windows.carry_stack_0033: Use the unchanged common window produced by CARRY-STACK-0033: 2023-06-19 through 2026-07-30.

carry_pnl_0031_benchmark.strategy_return: unchanged canonical 5 bps daily funding-aware CARRY-PNL-0031 return
carry_pnl_0031_benchmark.cash_return: DTB3 daily return for the same dates
carry_pnl_0031_benchmark.excess_cagr_over_rf: strategy CAGR minus compounded DTB3 cash CAGR on the identical date span
carry_pnl_0031_benchmark.net_economics: PASS only if excess_cagr_over_rf > 0. No zero-return hurdle remains.

carry_stack_0033_benchmark.principle: Only the CARRY-STACK-0033 carry_scale displaces idle cash. The matched cash alternative therefore earns carry_scale * rf_daily while BRRK is unchanged.
carry_stack_0033_benchmark.excess_cagr_over_rf: combined strategy CAGR minus BRRK-plus-idle-cash benchmark CAGR on the identical date span
carry_stack_0033_benchmark.net_economics: PASS only if excess_cagr_over_rf > 0. Existing 0033 qualification remains historical evidence and is not retuned.

required_outputs: old published CARRY-PNL-0031 metrics preserved verbatim alongside risk-free-restated metrics
old published CARRY-STACK-0033 metrics preserved verbatim alongside risk-free-restated metrics
excess_cagr_over_rf and excess_sharpe_over_rf for both source experiments
annual carry-vs-cash tables for both source experiments
daily CARRY-PNL-0031 return, cash return and excess return
daily CARRY-STACK-0033 combined return, BRRK-plus-cash benchmark return, scaled carry return, scaled cash return and excess return
FRED raw-source digest and requested window metadata
decision_rule: If CARRY-PNL-0031 fails corrected net_economics, stop the carry research line under discipline #7, mark CARRY-PM-0035 and its measurement-integrity successor as not required, and do not attempt a funding sign filter, asset removal, basis filter, shorter window, threshold change, leverage change, or any same-window rescue.
prohibited: no window restriction or start-date change
no benchmark substitution after observing results
no threshold tuning after observing results
